behaviour: A ledger warning raised through raise_warning or built through new_alert needs only the revision and the time of the sync that raises it, not the whole op context: an open alert of the same text, or of the same sync writer and item, is left alone or has its last refusal time moved; a closed alert whose text is already known before the first alert of its sync is not raised again; every other case appends one new alert row carrying that revision and time and marks the context dirty.
